source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this model has shot, pick one enemy unit that is neither a MONSTER nor a VEHICLE and that at least one of those attacks hit. For the rest of the phase, ranged attacks by your DEATH GUARD units against that enemy unit have their Armour Penetration improved by 1. This ability can affect the same enemy unit no more than once per phase.

select.condition: hit by one or more of those attacks

effect.attacks: ranged attacks by friendly DEATH GUARD units targeting that unit

fields.limit: same enemy unit affected at most once per phase
